containment.mechanism: Independently reviewed exact source with authored VM collaborators; VM is not a security boundary. Closed child environment, shell=False, hidden direct Node child. subprocess.run kills/waits its direct child on timeout. No spawn API is used by reviewed program or target in its supplied context.
containment.file_reads: Pinned program reads only exact pinned target; no project module import. Parent reads only binding, independent review and listed pinned inputs.
containment.effects: Authored synthetic fetch/media/Word/storage only; no browser, real device, application, database, provider, network or Git operation.
containment.limits: No hard CPU/memory/job/process caps asserted; one reviewed direct child,120s timeout,1s VM individual calls.
containment.cleanup: Direct child completes or timeout kills/reaps; evidence files retained; no disposable database/listener or child-created persistent fixtures.
